email.subject: Quick fix for Velvet Hair Studio's site
email.body:
Hi Ivy,

I checked Velvet Hair Studio's site. A few things are likely costing you bookings:

Your photos are huge files (10-12MB each), so pages crawl to load on phones - most visitors bail before they even see your work. And there's no reviews section, which matters a lot for a salon since people choose stylists based on trust from others.

I fix things like this for a flat fee. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough where I show you exactly what's slowing things down and what it'd take to fix?

Alex
Northlight Web
